values.note: Standard electric (full-hookup) sites $46 a night in recreation.gov's 2026, 2027 and 2028 peak-season rate tables; the only off-peak rate on file ($37) is for April 2024.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233573/rates (Peak Season 2026-05-22 to 2026-09-06, 2027 and 2028: STANDARD ELECTRIC $46), read 2026-10-20

hookups.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/search/campsites?fq=asset_id%3A233573 (all 124 campsites list Water Hookup Y and Sewer Hookup Y; 63 list 50-amp electric, 61 list 30-amp), read 2026-10-20

values.note: 124 standard electric campsites, all full hookup; sites 69 and 71 are accessible sites for Access-pass holders. Listed max vehicle length runs 41 to 75 ft by site, most 48-66 ft. Every site is listed back-in on gravel. One wheeled camper and one tent per site, two vehicles maximum, no parking on the grass.

sites.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/search/campsites?fq=asset_id%3A233573 (site type, Max Vehicle Length, Driveway Entry, Driveway Surface) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233573 (notices), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Shower houses and restrooms throughout the campground; playground. A swimming beach (no lifeguards) on Tionesta Creek outside the campground entrance.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233573 (Facilities: 'Shower houses and restrooms are located throughout the campground'; amenities: Dump Station, Flush Toilets, Showers, Playground; Recreation: beach outside the entrance), read 2026-10-20

values.note: 'All campers must have a reservation in order to camp. Reservations need to be made before arrival.' Reservations can be made up to the day of arrival (cutoff 0 days). 14 nights in any 30 consecutive days at the project. Check-in 2 p.m., check-out noon.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233573 (notices; facility_rules maxConsecutiveStay 14, maxStay 14 per rolling 30 days, reservationCutOff 0 days prior to arrival), read 2026-10-20

note: USACE campground below Tionesta Dam along Tionesta Creek (Pittsburgh District). Reservation required, on recreation.gov only. 124 back-in full-hookup sites (63 with 50-amp), listed for rigs of about 41-75 ft. A few sites (e.g. 46, 48) back up above the creek; not step-to-water lakefront. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $46 (2026-2028 peak rate tables), 50-amp with water and sewer at every site, reservable on rec.gov. Changed max_rig_ft 40 -> 75 (catalog lengths 41-75 ft; the derived 40 came from the note). Added 124 sites all back-in, showers/flush toilets/dump, reservation-only (fcfs never), 14-night max. Note corrected (length and hookups were wrong). Season not stated (rate-season dates only; the USACE district site did not load). rec.gov's militaryDiscount rule flag has no prose; not recorded.
